== fresh hero: panel shown; meta "0 of 5 done"
  div.banners (hidden)
  div.welcome
    section.welcome-card
      h3.- "Welcome. Your hero plays by itself."
      ul.lines
        li.- "d.idle plays your Diablo II hero for you: it fights, loots, heals and walks town. You watch, and you decide what matters."
        li.- "It does not touch your gear or your gold. You equip what you find and you decide what to buy; selling junk is yours to mark."
        li.- "Worn gear is repaired with one button, and you can order any area on the map when you want the hero somewhere else."
        li.- "The Journey strip shows the path ahead. You never have to follow it."
        li.- "Policies are the rules the hero lives by: open the policy sheet and pick how careful it should be."
      div.btnrow
        a.d-btn [welcome-inventory] href=/watch/inventory "Open Inventory"
        a.d-btn [welcome-policy] href=/watch/policy "Open Policy"
        a.d-btn [welcome-journey] href=#p-journey-title "Show the Journey"
        button.d-btn [welcome-dismiss] "Got it, hide this"
  div.help (hidden)
  div.art (hidden)
  div.list
    section.check
      div.check-head
        h3.- "Your first 30 minutes"
        span.meta "0 of 5 done"
        button.d-btn [check-fold] "Hide the list"
      ol.steps
        li.step done=0
          span.tick "to do"
          a.d-btn name [step-equip] href=/watch/inventory "Equip your starter gear"
          span.hint "The hero never equips for you. The inventory page tells you what is worth wearing."
          button.d-btn [tick-equip] "Mark done"
        li.step done=0
          span.tick "to do"
          a.d-btn name [step-policy] href=/watch/policy "Check the policy sheet"
          span.hint "Each row is a rule the hero follows. The defaults are safe."
          button.d-btn [tick-policy] "Mark done"
        li.step done=0
          span.tick "to do"
          a.d-btn name [step-fight] href=#p-video-title "Watch your first fight"
          span.hint "It ticks by itself after the first kill. Watch the video or the Thoughts feed."
          button.d-btn [tick-fight] "Mark done"
        li.step done=0
          span.tick "to do"
          a.d-btn name [step-journey] href=#p-journey-title "Open the Journey strip"
          span.hint "The path through the game, one chapter at a time."
          button.d-btn [tick-journey] "Mark done"
        li.step done=0
          span.tick "to do"
          a.d-btn name [step-junk] href=/watch/inventory "Mark junk for sale"
          span.hint "Mark an item in the inventory and the hero sells it on the next town visit."
          button.d-btn [tick-junk] "Mark done"

          span.hint "Each row is a rule the hero follows. The defaults are safe."
          button.d-btn [tick-policy] "Mark done"
        li.step done=1
          span.tick "done"
          a.d-btn name [step-fight] href=#p-video-title "Watch your first fight"
          span.hint "It ticks by itself after the first kill. Watch the video or the Thoughts feed."
        li.step done=0
          span.tick "to do"
          a.d-btn name [step-journey] href=#p-journey-title "Open the Journey strip"
          span.hint "The path through the game, one chapter at a time."
          button.d-btn [tick-journey] "Mark done"
        li.step done=0
          span.tick "to do"
          a.d-btn name [step-junk] href=/watch/inventory "Mark junk for sale"
          span.hint "Mark an item in the inventory and the hero sells it on the next town visit."
          button.d-btn [tick-junk] "Mark done"
